periods.description: The fallen empire that once ruled one fifth of the world and imposed oppressive patriarchal rule before being overthrown five years before volume 1.
periods.history: Under the emperor, the empire monopolized Drag-Rides, oppressed women, imposed heavy taxes, and conducted abusive military policies. It collapsed during the coup shaped by Lux, Earl Atismata, and Fugil's betrayal.
periods.goals: Historically, preserve imperial domination and military monopoly; remnants seek restoration.
periods.structure: Imperial family, emperor, court nobles, imperial military, and Drag-Knight forces.
